THE STORY
Down 2-3 in the third and then short-handed, which is not where you draw up a comeback.

Perry Mayer went off for tripping at 4:45. Dylan Tadros tied it short-handed at 4:14. Thirty
seconds later, still on the same kill, Alex Albano scored the winner at 3:44. Two short-handed
goals on one penalty, and the game turned over in half a minute.

Home opener. 4-3.
